ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixels are predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to distal tip regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped depression with deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations; contains a significant macro-scale rectangular void or missing segment on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric sweep; the left lobe displays a truncated, roughly rectangular trajectory, whereas the right lobe exhibits a more typical tapered, convex upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (calcified deposits) concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the dark surface pigmentation on the central and left-lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent missing tissue segment on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch; heavy barnacle colonization at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Nearly uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible ventral surface, lacking typical white mottling.
